The checker matched the word "input" in a comment (`# input pair gm/Id`), not an actual call. I removed it and cleaned up two leftover expressions (`mps_vds if False else 0.3` and `None or 0.65`).

I also raised the default tail current from 160 µA to 180 µA. The predicted unity-gain bandwidth was only about 2.3 MHz against the 2 MHz spec. At 180 µA it is about 2.6 MHz, for roughly 450 µW total. At the 200 µA upper bound, power is about 486 µW, still under the 500 µW limit.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),       # diff pair L
    "itail": (180e-6, 120e-6, 200e-6),
    "icasc": (15e-6, 8e-6, 40e-6),   # cascode branch current
    "gmid_ps": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),    # PMOS folding current sources
    "Lps":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_c": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),     # cascode devices (n & p)
    "Lc":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "gmid_n": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),     # bottom NMOS mirror
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_b": (12.0, 8.0, 14.0),     # ibias reference / tail mirror
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
}

def _pick(lut, dev, L, I, vgs_target, vsb=0.0):
    # diode-connected bias device: find gm/Id giving the wanted |Vgs|
    best, berr = None, 1e9
    for g in np.linspace(2.5, 16.0, 55):
        try:
            op = lut.size(dev, float(g), L, I, vds=vgs_target, vsb=vsb)
        except Exception:
            continue
        err = abs(op.vgs - vgs_target)
        if err < berr:
            best, berr = op, err
    if best is None:
        best = lut.size(dev, 8.0, L, I, vds=vgs_target, vsb=vsb)
    return best

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-10)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    it, ic = p["itail"], p["icasc"]
    i1 = it / 2.0
    ips = i1 + ic

    # ---- core devices ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.3)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.15)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6, vsb=vtail)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.15)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["Lb"], it, vds=vtail)
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.65)

    mps = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ps"], p["Lps"], ips, vds=0.3)
    vsd_ps = mps.vdsat + 0.15
    vfold = VDD - vsd_ps
    mps = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ps"], p["Lps"], ips, vds=vsd_ps)
    mcp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_c"], p["Lc"], ic, vds=max(vfold - vcm, 0.3), vsb=vsd_ps)

    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], ic, vds=0.3)
    vds5 = mn.vdsat + 0.15
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], ic, vds=vds5)
    mcn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["Lc"], ic, vds=max(vcm - vds5, 0.3), vsb=vds5)

    # ---- bias generation ----
    mb_n = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.9)        # ibias-mirrored 10uA sinks
    mb_p = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ps"], p["Lps"], iref, vds=mps.vgs)   # vbp1 diode / PMOS 10uA source
    vbp2 = vfold - mcp.vgs
    mdp = _pick(lut, "p", 1.0, iref, VDD - vbp2)                     # vbp2 diode
    vbn2 = vds5 + mcn.vgs
    mdn = _pick(lut, "n", 1.0, iref, vbn2)                           # vbn2 diode

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "f1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "f2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "f1", "vbp1", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
    n.dev("M4", "f2", "vbp1", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
    n.dev("MC3", "x", "vbp2", "f1", "vdd", mcp)
    n.dev("MC4", "vout", "vbp2", "f2", "vdd", mcp)
    n.dev("MC5", "x", "vbn2", "s5", "vss", mcn)
    n.dev("MC6", "vout", "vbn2", "s6", "vss", mcn)
    n.dev("M5", "s5", "x", "vss", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("M6", "s6", "x", "vss", "vss", mn)
    # vbp1
    n.dev("MB1", "vbp1", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb_n)
    n.dev("MB2", "vbp1", "vbp1", "vdd", "vdd", mb_p)
    # vbp2
    n.dev("MB3", "vbp2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb_n)
    n.dev("MB4", "vbp2", "vbp2", "vdd", "vdd", mdp)
    # vbn2
    n.dev("MB5", "vbn2", "vbp1", "vdd", "vdd", mb_p)
    n.dev("MB6", "vbn2", "vbn2", "vss", "vss", mdn)

    # ---- predictions ----
    rup = (mcp.gm + mcp.gmbs) / mcp.gds / (mps.gds + m1.gds)
    rdn = (mcn.gm + mcn.gmbs) / mcn.gds / mn.gds
    rout = rup * rdn / (rup + rdn)
    a0 = m1.gm * rout
    cout = cl + mcp.cdd + mcn.cdd
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * cout)
    cf = m1.cdd + mps.cdd + mcp.cgg
    pf = (mcp.gm + mcp.gmbs) / (2 * PI * cf)
    cx = 2 * mn.cgg + mcp.cdd + mcn.cdd
    px = mn.gm / (2 * PI * cx)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pf)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / px))
    itot = iref + 3 * iref + 2 * ips
    return n, {"gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": VDD * itot,
               "slew": it / cl}
```
